armour.label: Armour
armour.hint: Armour Points on every hit location.

ward.label: Ward
ward.hint: Ignores a wound on a d10 roll of at least this value.

size.label: Size
size.hint: Larger creatures hit harder and are easier to hit.

fear.label: Fear / Terror
fear.hint: Enemies must pass a Cool test or become broken.

frenzy.label: Frenzy
frenzy.hint: Enters a Frenzy on a Willpower test: an extra melee attack each round and +1 damage, immune to other psychology; Fatigued afterwards.

hatred.label: Hatred
hatred.hint: +1 SL against the named group in melee and at range, ignores its Fear. Put the group in the name, in brackets, as written in the race or creature type field (e.g. Goblins).

animosity.label: Animosity
animosity.hint: Must pass a Psychology test when meeting the named group. Put the group in the name, in brackets, as written in the race or creature type field (e.g. Goblins).

regenerate.label: Regenerate
regenerate.hint: Regains Wounds at the start of its turn (1d10; at 0 Wounds only on 8+). Wounds from fire do not regenerate.

ranged.label: Ranged
ranged.hint: Missile or thrown attack; adds Strength Bonus.

undead.label: Undead
undead.hint: Counts as undead for effects that only work on the undead.

flier.label: Flier
flier.hint: Flies: ranged attacks against it count one range band further, and its own ranged attacks suffer -2 SL.

swarm.label: Swarm
swarm.hint: Engaged enemies lose 1 Wound at the end of each round, ranged attacks against it get +4 SL, ignores Size and psychology.

painless.label: Painless
painless.hint: Ignores the penalties of Critical Wounds except amputation; conditions still apply.
